description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'SQLiteUserDictionaryBase' that manages a user dictionary stored in an SQLite database for an Android application. It handles database creation, reading, error handling, and word management functionalities, serving as a base class for specific implementations.

classes.name: SQLiteUserDictionaryBase
classes.description: An abstract class that manages a user dictionary stored in an SQLite database, providing methods for reading, writing, and error handling related to the database.

methods.name: SQLiteUserDictionaryBase
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the dictionary with a name, context, and locale.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the locale associated with this dictionary.

methods.name: readWordsFromActualStorage
methods.description: Reads words from the SQLite database, handling exceptions and reinitializing the storage if needed.

methods.name: createStorage
methods.description: Creates a new WordsSQLiteConnection instance for the specified locale.

methods.name: addWordToStorage
methods.description: Adds a word with its frequency to the storage.

methods.name: deleteWordFromStorage
methods.description: Deletes a word from the storage.

methods.name: closeStorage
methods.description: Closes the storage connection and nullifies the reference.
